title: Solaris
author: Stanisław Lem
summary: A psychologist arrives at a research station above an ocean that may be alive, and finds the crew in a state of fear. Soon he is visited by the shape of someone he lost, and the ocean seems to be reading his mind.
readIf: you like quiet, strange science fiction that asks whether we could ever truly understand an alien mind.
skipIf: you want an adventure with answers, because the long passages about imagined science are intentionally frustrating.

pairings.reason: A modern, equally eerie look at a place that changes the people who enter it.
A more visionary and hopeful treatment of a human encounter with a vast intelligence.
